pages.title: Mekanism
pages.text: With Mekanism installed a fifth cable appears: the $(6)Gas Cable$(), built on Mekanism's chemical API. It configures exactly like the others, and its filter rules take chemical ids and chemical tags.$(br2)Without Mekanism the cable does not exist at all.

pages.title: Flux Networks
pages.text: Plugs and points already reach this mod through Forge Energy with nothing added.$(br2)What the integration adds is Flux's own long-precision interface on the cells, the cell item and the energy cable, so a tier 10 cell in a Flux network moves its real capacity instead of a figure clamped to two billion.

pages.title: Jade and JEI
pages.text: $(o)Jade$() shows what the face you are pointing at is doing, what upgrade it holds, how many rules it has, and the real charge of a cell.$(br2)$(o)JEI$() carries an information page for every block here, and lets you drag an ingredient straight out of it onto a filter rule.
